newsitem.title: USA: Stone Energy acquires Vermilion stake.
newsitem.headline: Stone Energy acquires Vermilion stake.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp said it acquired a 62.5 percent working interest in the oil and natural gas field of Vermilion Block 46 for $15.4 million on September 27.

The effective date of the purchase from a major oil company is August 1. In a separate transaction with a different company in 1993, the company purchased a 28 percent working interest in this field for $2.8 million.

The company said it plans to assign a portion of the acquired interest to two partnerships it manages and retain a 76 percent working interest with an about 65 percent net revenue interest in the field.
Vermilion Block 46 Field is located about 10 miles offshore Louisiana in water depth of 30 feet.

The interests acquired in Vermilion Block 46 Field consist of two producing wells and two shut-in wells tapping 2,500 acres in the northern half of the block. Productive reservoirs have been encountered historically between 3,000 and 15,500 feet.
Since the initial 1993 acquisition, development activities have been limited to the recompletion of one well.

In 1997, the company plans to drill three new wells and workover two existing wells, it said. The 1997 capital expenditures budget of $12.4 million also includes a new production platform which is dependent upon development results. At the date of acquisition, daily production from the field was approximately 3.8 million cubic feet of natural gas and 100 barrels of oil, Stone Energy said.
